evidence_requests.question: Screen the current partition for unsupported internal splits and weak pair boundaries.

observations.meaning: The structural calculations are performed on the candidate-generation consensus geometry, not on external validation or stability data.
observations.finding: Structural diagnostics describe the internal geometry of the current candidate partition only.

observations.meaning: For every candidate set the dominant spectral gap is at the single-cluster resolution, so the screening calculation does not show a dominant multi-cluster subdivision signal.
observations.finding: No candidate set exhibits a screening-level internal subdivision signal.

observations.meaning: Magnitude of the leading eigengap at k=1 for each set; a large leading gap describes dominance of the single-cluster resolution rather than internal multi-cluster substructure.
observations.finding: Leading gaps are large across all sets, consistent with single-cluster dominance at the screening resolution.

observations.meaning: Average candidate-generation consensus affinity among patients assigned to the same candidate set.
observations.finding: Within-set affinity is positive for all sets, with the smallest set (K5_C0005, n=4) and K5_C0001 (n=35) showing the lowest values.

observations.meaning: Number of patients represented in each structural calculation.
observations.finding: Set sizes range from 4 to 35 patients; the smallest set has limited representation.

observations.meaning: Relatively close candidate pairs and their between-set affinity; these are pair-review entry points, not merge conclusions.
observations.finding: The closest boundaries are K5_C0003–K5_C0005 and K5_C0001–K5_C0005, with between-set affinities of about 0.24 and 0.23 respectively; all listed between-set affinities are below the corresponding within-set affinities.

reports.dimension_interpretation: Partition-level structural diagnostics provide triage evidence on the current candidate partition. The internal screen shows candidate_k=1 for every set, meaning the dominant spectral gap sits at the single-cluster resolution and no dominant multi-cluster subdivision signal is present at this screening level; the large leading eigengaps (0.73–0.96) are consistent with single-cluster dominance rather than internal substructure. Within-set affinities are positive for all sets, and the nearest-pair affinities identify K5_C0003–K5_C0005 and K5_C0001–K5_C0005 as the relatively closest boundaries, with between-set affinities below within-set affinities. This pattern is coherent at the partition level but does not by itself establish biological meaning, clinical validity, or any accept, drop, split, or merge action.

reports.dimension_interpretation: At partition scope, several measured technical, acquisition, and site factors show statistically significant associations with the geometry: tissue source site (PERMANOVA r_squared 0.254, p 0.001, q 0.0025; PERMDISP nonsignificant), CT phase (r_squared 0.154, p 0.001, q 0.0025; PERMDISP significant), CT slice thickness (r_squared 0.136, p 0.001, q 0.002), CT z-spacing (r_squared 0.142, p 0.001, q 0.002), CT manufacturer (r_squared 0.059, p 0.004, q 0.0067; PERMDISP significant), CT pixel spacing (r_squared 0.019, p 0.035, q 0.035), and study year (r_squared 0.029, p 0.003, q 0.004). CT reconstruction kernel (p 0.048, q 0.054) and scanner model (p 0.054, q 0.054) do not survive their BH families. These are partition-wide associations and describe a partition-level technical concern; they must not be presented as candidate-specific confounder associations. Association is not causation, and a significant PERMANOVA is not proof of technical artifact. Where PERMDISP is significant (CT phase, manufacturer), PERMANOVA may reflect both location and dispersion.
reports.cross_evidence_context: This partition-scope confounder evidence is independent of the set-scope mutation-phenotype reports and of the partition-level structural screen. It indicates that measured technical/acquisition/site factors remain plausible alternative explanations for part of the partition-wide geometry, but it does not attribute confounding to any specific candidate set.
limitations: Partition-scope association describes a partition-wide technical concern and must not be presented as a candidate-specific confounder association.

plan.rationale: Router authorized merging K5_C0001 and K5_C0005 based on the weakest reviewed boundary: negligible independent two-way spectral ARI (0.044), high normalized-cut cost (0.904), elevated between-side affinity (0.230), and a single-cluster-dominated union eigengap (candidate_k=1, leading gap 0.733). Native-view geometry concurs that the boundary is not coherently expressed (CT, RNA, WXS near-zero; only WSI modest), and K5_C0005 lacks a defensible independent identity (no driver gene survives correction; n=4). This plan executes the exact authorized merge with the relevant structural metric refs; it is provisional and returns to normal review.

evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: Partition-level structural diagnostics on the candidate-generation consensus geometry show a coherent single-cluster resolution for every candidate set: the leading eigengap dominates at k=1 (0.73–0.96) with only small secondary gaps, and within-set affinity (0.36–0.68) substantially exceeds the nearest between-set affinities (0.11–0.15). This indicates the current partition's internal structure is represented as cohesive sets with relatively weak cross-set connectivity in this geometry. The screen does not identify any decision-relevant internal subdivision, and the nearest-pair affinities identify K5_C0002–K5_C0003 as the closest boundary for possible pair review. These are triage observations about the current partition geometry; they do not establish biological meaning, clinical validity, or any accept/drop/split/merge action.
limitations: Partition structural diagnostics are triage evidence and do not independently establish retention, split, or merge.
The geometry basis is candidate-generation consensus, not external validation or a stability score.
The internal screen reports only screening-level eigengap structure; it does not provide actual feasible k>=2 solutions or their measurements.
Absence of a subdivision signal is not evidence about independence from neighboring candidates.
Nearest-pair affinity is a review entry point, not a merge conclusion.
No modality-native (CT, WSI, RNA, WXS) patient-geometry results are available in this round, so cross-modal coherence cannot be assessed.
Structural or cross-modal evidence does not by itself establish biological meaning or clinical validity.

evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: This candidate shows an interpretable molecular phenotype relative to the rest of the partition: strong PBRM1 enrichment (OR 15.66, 95% CI 5.84–41.97; q_driver 4.95e-08, q_global 1.18e-05) and VHL enrichment (OR 3.97, 95% CI 1.66–9.52; q_driver 0.0104, q_global 1.0), with BAP1 depletion (OR 0.048; q_driver 0.0104, q_global 1.0). The PBRM1 signal is the only one surviving global multiplicity. CDKN2A was not estimable (no events in either group). Exploratory top genes (e.g., ATM OR 25.0) do not survive global multiplicity. Overall the pattern is coherent and directionally consistent with a PBRM1/VHL-enriched, BAP1-depleted molecular program, but this characterizes biological identity only and does not establish that current membership or granularity deserves retention.
limitations: Biological identity does not by itself establish that current membership, boundary, or granularity deserves independent retention.
Driver-panel membership is post-hoc prespecified ccRCC annotation, not a discovery feature-selection criterion.
q_driver and q_global are separate BH families and must not be conflated; only PBRM1 survives global multiplicity.
Exploratory top genes are a limited display subset; the full table is available at artifact_paths.
CDKN2A was not estimable (no events in either group); non-estimability is neither support nor contradiction.
Zero-cell Haldane-Anscombe correction was applied to some odds ratios; Fisher p-values use the uncorrected table.

evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: At partition scope, several measured technical, acquisition, and site factors show statistically significant associations with the geometry: tissue source site (PERMANOVA r_squared 0.254, p 0.001, q 0.0025; PERMDISP nonsignificant), CT phase (r_squared 0.154, p 0.001, q 0.0025; PERMDISP significant), CT slice thickness (r_squared 0.136, p 0.001, q 0.002), CT z-spacing (r_squared 0.142, p 0.001, q 0.002), CT manufacturer (r_squared 0.059, p 0.004, q 0.0067; PERMDISP significant), CT pixel spacing (r_squared 0.019, p 0.035, q 0.035), and study year (r_squared 0.029, p 0.003, q 0.004). CT reconstruction kernel (p 0.048, q 0.054) and scanner model (p 0.054, q 0.054) do not survive their BH families. These are partition-wide associations and describe a partition-level technical concern; they must not be presented as candidate-specific confounder associations. Association is not causation, and a significant PERMANOVA is not proof of technical artifact. Where PERMDISP is significant (CT phase, manufacturer), PERMANOVA may reflect both location and dispersion.
limitations: Partition-scope association describes a partition-wide technical concern and must not be presented as a candidate-specific confounder association.
A significant PERMANOVA is not proof of technical artifact or causation; nonsignificance does not establish absence of confounding.
PERMANOVA, PERMDISP, and continuous distance-regression p-values belong to separate BH families and must not be combined.
Factor r_squared values are univariable distance-based associations and must not be added or interpreted as independent causal variance explained.
Where PERMDISP is significant, PERMANOVA may reflect both location and dispersion.
PERMDISP was not estimable for CT reconstruction kernel and scanner model due to sparse levels.
No covariate adjustment or causal control was performed; persistence after adjustment is not established.

plan.rationale: Router authorized merging K5_C0001 and K5_C0005 based on the weakest reviewed boundary: negligible independent two-way spectral ARI (0.044), high normalized-cut cost (0.904), elevated between-side affinity (0.230), and a single-cluster-dominated union eigengap (candidate_k=1, leading gap 0.733). Native-view geometry concurs that the boundary is not coherently expressed (CT, RNA, WXS near-zero; only WSI modest), and K5_C0005 lacks a defensible independent identity (no driver gene survives correction; n=4). This plan executes the exact authorized merge with the relevant structural metric refs; it is provisional and returns to normal review.

evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: Partition-level structural diagnostics on the candidate-generation consensus geometry show a coherent single-cluster resolution for every candidate set: the leading eigengap dominates at k=1 (0.73–0.96) with only small secondary gaps, and within-set affinity (0.36–0.68) substantially exceeds the nearest between-set affinities (0.11–0.15). This indicates the current partition's internal structure is represented as cohesive sets with relatively weak cross-set connectivity in this geometry. The screen does not identify any decision-relevant internal subdivision, and the nearest-pair affinities identify K5_C0002–K5_C0003 as the closest boundary for possible pair review. These are triage observations about the current partition geometry; they do not establish biological meaning, clinical validity, or any accept/drop/split/merge action.

These are partition-wide associations and describe a partition-level technical concern; they must not be presented as candidate-specific confounder associations. Association is not causation, and a significant PERMANOVA is not proof of technical artifact. Where PERMDISP is significant (CT phase, manufacturer), PERMANOVA may reflect both location and dispersion.

plan.rationale: Router authorized merging K5_C0001 and K5_C0005 based on the weakest reviewed boundary: negligible independent two-way spectral ARI (0.044), high normalized-cut cost (0.904), elevated between-side affinity (0.230), and a single-cluster-dominated union eigengap (candidate_k=1, leading gap 0.733). Native-view geometry concurs that the boundary is not coherently expressed (CT, RNA, WXS near-zero; only WSI modest), and K5_C0005 lacks a defensible independent identity (no driver gene survives correction; n=4). This plan executes the exact authorized merge with the relevant structural metric refs; it is provisional and returns to normal review.

evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: Partition-level structural diagnostics on the candidate-generation consensus geometry show a coherent single-cluster resolution for every candidate set: the leading eigengap dominates at k=1 (0.73–0.96) with only small secondary gaps, and within-set affinity (0.36–0.68) substantially exceeds the nearest between-set affinities (0.11–0.15). This indicates the current partition's internal structure is represented as cohesive sets with relatively weak cross-set connectivity in this geometry. The screen does not identify any decision-relevant internal subdivision, and the nearest-pair affinities identify K5_C0002–K5_C0003 as the closest boundary for possible pair review. These are triage observations about the current partition geometry; they do not establish biological meaning, clinical validity, or any accept/drop/split/merge action.

evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: This candidate shows an interpretable molecular phenotype relative to the rest of the partition: strong PBRM1 enrichment (OR 15.66, 95% CI 5.84–41.97; q_driver 4.95e-08, q_global 1.18e-05) and VHL enrichment (OR 3.97, 95% CI 1.66–9.52; q_driver 0.0104, q_global 1.0), with BAP1 depletion (OR 0.048; q_driver 0.0104, q_global 1.0). The PBRM1 signal is the only one surviving global multiplicity. CDKN2A was not estimable (no events in either group). Exploratory top genes (e.g., ATM OR 25.0) do not survive global multiplicity. Overall the pattern is coherent and directionally consistent with a PBRM1/VHL-enriched, BAP1-depleted molecular program, but this characterizes biological identity only and does not establish that current membership or granularity deserves retention.
limitations: Biological identity does not by itself establish that current membership, boundary, or granularity deserves independent retention.

q_driver and q_global are separate BH families and must not be conflated; only PBRM1 survives global multiplicity.
Exploratory top genes are a limited display subset; the full table is available at artifact_paths.
CDKN2A was not estimable (no events in either group); non-estimability is neither support nor contradiction.

plan.rationale: Router authorized merging K5_C0001 and K5_C0005 based on the weakest reviewed boundary: negligible independent two-way spectral ARI (0.044), high normalized-cut cost (0.904), elevated between-side affinity (0.230), and a single-cluster-dominated union eigengap (candidate_k=1, leading gap 0.733). Native-view geometry concurs that the boundary is not coherently expressed (CT, RNA, WXS near-zero; only WSI modest), and K5_C0005 lacks a defensible independent identity (no driver gene survives correction; n=4). This plan executes the exact authorized merge with the relevant structural metric refs; it is provisional and returns to normal review.

evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: Partition-level structural diagnostics on the candidate-generation consensus geometry show a coherent single-cluster resolution for every candidate set: the leading eigengap dominates at k=1 (0.73–0.96) with only small secondary gaps, and within-set affinity (0.36–0.68) substantially exceeds the nearest between-set affinities (0.11–0.15). This indicates the current partition's internal structure is represented as cohesive sets with relatively weak cross-set connectivity in this geometry. The screen does not identify any decision-relevant internal subdivision, and the nearest-pair affinities identify K5_C0002–K5_C0003 as the closest boundary for possible pair review. These are triage observations about the current partition geometry; they do not establish biological meaning, clinical validity, or any accept/drop/split/merge action.
limitations: Partition structural diagnostics are triage evidence and do not independently establish retention, split, or merge.
The geometry basis is candidate-generation consensus, not external validation or a stability score.
The internal screen reports only screening-level eigengap structure; it does not provide actual feasible k>=2 solutions or their measurements.
Absence of a subdivision signal is not evidence about independence from neighboring candidates.
Nearest-pair affinity is a review entry point, not a merge conclusion.
No modality-native (CT, WSI, RNA, WXS) patient-geometry results are available in this round, so cross-modal coherence cannot be assessed.
Structural or cross-modal evidence does not by itself establish biological meaning or clinical validity.

evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: This candidate shows an interpretable molecular phenotype relative to the rest of the partition: strong PBRM1 enrichment (OR 15.66, 95% CI 5.84–41.97; q_driver 4.95e-08, q_global 1.18e-05) and VHL enrichment (OR 3.97, 95% CI 1.66–9.52; q_driver 0.0104, q_global 1.0), with BAP1 depletion (OR 0.048; q_driver 0.0104, q_global 1.0). The PBRM1 signal is the only one surviving global multiplicity. CDKN2A was not estimable (no events in either group). Exploratory top genes (e.g., ATM OR 25.0) do not survive global multiplicity. Overall the pattern is coherent and directionally consistent with a PBRM1/VHL-enriched, BAP1-depleted molecular program, but this characterizes biological identity only and does not establish that current membership or granularity deserves retention.
limitations: Biological identity does not by itself establish that current membership, boundary, or granularity deserves independent retention.
Driver-panel membership is post-hoc prespecified ccRCC annotation, not a discovery feature-selection criterion.
q_driver and q_global are separate BH families and must not be conflated; only PBRM1 survives global multiplicity.
Exploratory top genes are a limited display subset; the full table is available at artifact_paths.
CDKN2A was not estimable (no events in either group); non-estimability is neither support nor contradiction.
Zero-cell Haldane-Anscombe correction was applied to some odds ratios; Fisher p-values use the uncorrected table.

evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: At partition scope, several measured technical, acquisition, and site factors show statistically significant associations with the geometry: tissue source site (PERMANOVA r_squared 0.254, p 0.001, q 0.0025; PERMDISP nonsignificant), CT phase (r_squared 0.154, p 0.001, q 0.0025; PERMDISP significant), CT slice thickness (r_squared 0.136, p 0.001, q 0.002), CT z-spacing (r_squared 0.142, p 0.001, q 0.002), CT manufacturer (r_squared 0.059, p 0.004, q 0.0067; PERMDISP significant), CT pixel spacing (r_squared 0.019, p 0.035, q 0.035), and study year (r_squared 0.029, p 0.003, q 0.004). CT reconstruction kernel (p 0.048, q 0.054) and scanner model (p 0.054, q 0.054) do not survive their BH families. These are partition-wide associations and describe a partition-level technical concern; they must not be presented as candidate-specific confounder associations. Association is not causation, and a significant PERMANOVA is not proof of technical artifact. Where PERMDISP is significant (CT phase, manufacturer), PERMANOVA may reflect both location and dispersion.
limitations: Partition-scope association describes a partition-wide technical concern and must not be presented as a candidate-specific confounder association.
A significant PERMANOVA is not proof of technical artifact or causation; nonsignificance does not establish absence of confounding.

No covariate adjustment or causal control was performed; persistence after adjustment is not established.
